places.n: 七越茶屋 (Nanakoshi Chaya)
places.hood: Toba (near Toba Stn, close to Toba Aquarium)
places.notes: [Mom & Pop] A family-run teahouse-style udon restaurant that has operated for roughly 50 years a short walk from Toba Station, near the aquarium. It is regarded locally as a go-to spot for Ise udon, with the shop's dashi tare passed down across generations using tamari-style soy sauce.
places.chef: family-run udon and regional-cuisine restaurant · Toba, Mie (Ise-Shima) · A family-run teahouse-style udon restaurant that has operated for over 50 years, about a 7-minute walk from Toba Station near Toba Bay. It is regarded locally as a go-to spot for Ise udon, with the shop's dashi tare passed down across generations using inherited tamari-style soy sauce. · Carry forward a homestyle, generations-deep recipe for Ise udon and the regional fisherman's dish of tekone sushi. · Ise udon — thick, soft noodles boiled long (about 40 minutes) and dressed in a dark, gently sweet soy-and-fish tare that pools beneath the bowl — and tekone sushi, soy-marinated bonito over vinegared rice with shredded egg, seaweed and shiso. Tekone sushi fish is marinated in a soy-based sauce. Tempura (karaage/tempura udon) is on the menu, indicating a shared fryer; no dedicated gluten-free fryer or gluten-free menu exists. No allergy program documented.

places.notes: A long-standing Toba seafood restaurant a short walk from the station, marked by its big 漣 signboard, with its own parking lot across the road. It draws long lines in season, getting through as much as 60kg of shrimp on a busy day.
